The preview pane and separate reader offer unsubscribe when a received message has usable List-Unsubscribe metadata. Standard options use the Unsubscribe banner above the body. Gmail API, Outlook, Yahoo and other IMAP mail depend on the headers supplied by the sender and provider. New downloads capture these headers. Older cached mail keeps its available body and needs an explicit Reload message or Retry download to check missing headers; there is no automatic metadata download on ordinary open. Messages without usable metadata, drafts, Outbox and Local Folders have no banner. Choose Unsubscribe to review the mailbox and destination in a native confirmation. Web links open your browser, where cookies, redirects and further website steps can apply; opening a page does not confirm removal. Mailto opens an editable email for review, without automatic Cc/Bcc or a signature. For mailto, nothing sends until you choose Send. Recognized Google Groups +unsubscribe@googlegroups.com mailto addresses instead show Leave Google Group… in the reader’s Organize menu. Sending requests to leave the group, not just stop mail from the sender. Cancel sends no request and opens no website. Pending and completed handoffs are not repeated in the same reader window; uncertain outcomes require checking the browser or compose window. RFC 8058 one-click requests require native confirmation, a fresh complete original message (IMAP streams up to 64 MiB; Gmail uses a bounded download up to 35 MiB), and independently verified DKIM covering both unsubscribe headers and the complete body. Only verified exact HTTPS destinations receive the fixed POST with public DNS pinned to the connection, TLS verification, no cookies or credentials, no redirects and no automatic retry. Verification failure offers a separately confirmed manual alternative. A successful response means accepted request, not confirmed removal; rejected or uncertain POSTs never fall back automatically. No bulk unsubscribe, automatic unsubscribe, bot/CLI command or new provider permission is added.
